tables.name: Crime
tables.description: Modified by Population Density, Law Enforcement and Population Wealth. Crime in a village is likely rare and, when it does occur, swiftly dealt with.

results.name: Average
results.description: Theft or violence can happen from time to time. Best to keep an eye out. (+3 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Uncommon
results.description: Crime does not occur often but, when it does, it is a noteworthy occurrence. (+2 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Rare
results.description: Most villagers have had no personal experience with crime, and few know people that have. (+1 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Little-to-None
results.description: Most, or all, of the villagers believe the village is totally safe, and certainly haven’t experienced any crime personally. (+0 to urban encounter rolls)
